h1: The 6 Best Ninja Air Fryers of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Ninja Air Fryers 2026: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: the 6 best Ninja air fryers, from compact 4-quart baskets to 10-quart DualZone models, compared on capacity and cooking modes.
summary: The Ninja DZ201 Foodi 8 Quart DualZone is our top pick for most households. The DZ401 10 Quart adds family-sized room, and the DZ550 adds a built-in cook thermometer. The 4 Quart Ninja Air Fryer is the budget buy for one or two people, and the Ninja Air Fryer Pro at 5 quarts sits between small and large.
intro: Ninja's lineup confuses buyers because the names barely differ. The real divide is single basket versus DualZone: two baskets let you cook two foods at once and finish them together, which a single 4 or 5 quart drawer cannot.
We reviewed Ninja models on paper, comparing capacity, basket layout, and listed cooking modes. Models with unconfirmed capacity or overlapping listings were left out.

products.name: Ninja DZ201 Foodi 8 Quart 6-in-1 DualZone 2-Basket Air Fryer with 2
products.verdict: Two baskets and Smart Finish for the best all-round value.
products.description:
The DZ201 is an 8 quart, 6-in-1 DualZone air fryer with two baskets. Its Match Cook and Smart Finish features are meant to get two different foods done at the same moment, and it also roasts, broils, and dehydrates. It sits in the $100 to $200 bracket.

Compared with the 10 quart DZ401 it gives up two quarts of room but fits more countertops and costs about the same. The single-basket models cannot cook two foods at once.

Choose it if you cook for two to four people and want side dishes done together. The caveat is that it still needs a decent amount of counter space.
products.idealFor: Households of two to four cooking mains and sides.
products.skipIf: You cook for one and have little counter room.

products.name: Ninja DZ401 Foodi 10 Quart 6-in-1 DualZone XL 2-Basket Air Fryer with
products.verdict: Ten quarts of family-sized space across two baskets.
products.description:
The DZ401 is a 10 quart DualZone XL with two baskets and the same 6-in-1 modes as the DZ201, including Match Cook, Smart Finish, broil, and dehydrate. It is priced at $100 to $200.

It trails the DZ201 only because two extra quarts of volume are not needed by smaller households, and the footprint grows with them. Against the DZ550, it lacks the cook thermometer.

Buy it if you feed four or more people. The caveat is the size, which crowds a small kitchen.

products.name: Ninja DZ550 Foodi 10 Quart 6-in-1 DualZone Smart XL Air Fryer with 2
products.verdict: Adds a cook thermometer to the 10 quart DualZone design.
products.description:
The DZ550 is a 10 quart, 6-in-1 DualZone Smart XL with a cook thermometer for judging doneness, plus Match and Finish and dehydrate modes. It sits in the $100 to $200 bracket.

The thermometer is what separates it from the DZ401, giving you a way to cook meat to temperature rather than by timer. Otherwise the size and baskets match.

Choose it if you roast meats often and want doneness control. The caveat is that the thermometer adds a step to every cook.
products.idealFor: Cooks who roast meats and want temperature control.
products.skipIf: You never cook large cuts of meat.

products.name: Ninja Air Fryer Pro
products.verdict: A 5 quart single basket with four cooking modes.
products.description:
The Ninja Air Fryer Pro (AF141) offers a 5 quart basket and 4-in-1 cooking. It is in the $100 to $200 bracket.

The jump from the 4 quart to 5 quarts is modest, but at this price you can also see DualZone models in the same bracket, which cook two things at once. That keeps it fourth.

Buy it if you want one basket and a small body. The caveat is that DualZone is available for similar money.
products.idealFor: Singles and couples wanting a mid-size basket.
products.skipIf: You want to cook two foods at once.

products.name: Ninja Air Fryer
products.description:
This is a 4 quart Ninja air fryer with 4-in-1 cooking: crisp, roast, reheat, and one more mode. It is the cheapest pick here at $50 to $100.

It sits below the Air Fryer Pro because the basket is a quart smaller, though it saves money and counter space. It cannot match any DualZone model for versatility.

Buy it if you cook for one or two. The caveat is that a family's portions will need batches.
products.idealFor: One or two people on a budget.
products.skipIf: You regularly feed three or more.

products.name: Ninja Crispi Glass Air Fryer
products.verdict: A 4-in-1 Ninja with a glass design (model FN101GY).
products.description:
The Ninja Crispi Glass Air Fryer (FN101GY) is a 4-in-1 model priced at $100 to $200. The spec data we have does not list its capacity.

It lands sixth because its missing capacity makes it hard to compare against the 4 and 5 quart baskets, and it costs more than the entry model. The glass design is the draw.

Buy it if you prefer the glass look. The caveat is that you should confirm capacity on the listing.
products.idealFor: Buyers who prefer a glass design.

whatMatters.detail: DualZone models have two baskets that cook separately, and Smart Finish times them to finish together. Single baskets cook one food at a time. If you cook a main and a side, DualZone saves real time; check the listing for '2-Basket'.
Quarts measure basket volume. A 4 quart basket suits one or two people, while 8 to 10 quarts suits families. Match the number to your usual portions, found in the product title.
4-in-1 models crisp, roast, and reheat, while 6-in-1 adds broil and dehydrate. More modes only matter if you will use them. Read the mode list in the bullets.
A probe lets you cook meat to a temperature rather than a time. The DZ550 lists one. Check the listing for 'cook thermometer' if doneness matters.
A 10 quart unit is a large appliance. If you have little counter room, a 4 or 5 quart model is easier to live with. Check the listed dimensions.

faq.q: Do the DZ401 and DZ550 differ much?
faq.a: Both are 10 quart DualZone models with two baskets. The DZ550 adds a cook thermometer, which is the main difference.

faq.q: What mistake do buyers make with Ninja air fryers?
faq.a: Assuming bigger is better. A 10 quart unit takes a lot of counter room for small portions.

faq.q: Is DualZone worth it over a single basket?
faq.a: Yes if you cook a main and a side together. Smart Finish times both to end at once.

faq.q: How do I set one up?
faq.a: Wash the baskets, place the unit on a heat-safe surface with clearance on all sides, and preheat as the manual directs.

faq.q: How do I clean the baskets?
faq.a: Wipe them after use and wash with a non-abrasive sponge. Check the manual for dishwasher guidance.

faq.q: Can I cook frozen food straight in?
faq.a: Air fryers are generally used this way, and a 4 quart or larger basket handles it. Follow package directions.

finalTake: The Ninja DZ201 is the best all-round pick, offering two baskets and Smart Finish at a reasonable size. Go for the DZ550 if you roast meat, or the 4 quart Ninja Air Fryer on a budget. Match the basket count and capacity to your household before you look at anything else.
